Introduction
Grass Airdrop One
Airdrop One is the first token distribution event for the Grass network, aimed at rewarding early adopters and contributors.
Airdrop One allocates 100,000,000 GRASS (10% of total supply) to early users and community members as follows:
9% to users who earned Grass Points during Stage 1 (the Network Snapshot),
0.5% to GigaBuds NFT holders, and
0.5% to users who installed the Desktop Node or the Saga Application.
The Network Snapshot includes all users who earned more than 500 Grass Points in a given epoch.
Final allocations can be viewed here:
grassfoundation.io/claim
.
Epoch Allocations:
Allocations for each epoch are divided into nine tiers. Tiers are determined based on Grass Points earned from network uptime and referrals, with higher Grass Points placing participants in higher tiers.
Every eligible user will be rewarded for their Grass Points, however, the method and timing will differ based on your jurisdiction.
A total of 4,996,015 tokens are distributed equally among all GigaBuds NFTs as of the
snapshot block
, excluding any NFTs that were listed at the time of the snapshot. Eligible wallets will receive 515 Grass tokens per GigaBud NFT.
In order to reward the adoption of new Grass distribution channels, 5,000,000 GRASS are distributed equally among all accounts that have installed the Desktop Node or Saga Application and earned 500 or more Grass Points in a given epoch prior to October 11, 2024 at 05:00 UTC.
Starting October 28th, 2024, at 13:30 UTC, eligible addresses can claim their tokens by visiting
grassfoundation.io/claim
. To be eligible for Airdrop One, you must have earned 500+ Grass Points in any epoch and linked your wallet on the grass dashboard, before October 14, 2024, at 20:00 UTC. The claiming period for those eligible for Airdrop One, was extended. The extended claiming window has ended on block 329341917 or roughly March 27, 2025.
Please note:
grassfoundation.io
is the only official site for claiming or viewing your Grass Airdrop One allocation. Neither the claiming site nor any member of Wynd Labs or Grass Foundation will ever ask for your private key or request token transfers.
